usageNotes: Run this once on any node in the cluster before installing OSDs or creating pools; it writes ceph.conf and sets up required symlinks. The call is idempotent — re-running it when a [global] section already exists preserves the existing fsid, auth, and pool defaults, so it is safe to retry. Requires Sys.Modify on the root path; the node must be online and reachable by the PVE API.

examples.summary: Initialize Ceph on pve1 with a dedicated replication/heartbeat VLAN and standard 3-replica defaults

tips: Set 'network' and 'cluster-network' to separate CIDRs (storage vs. replication) for best isolation; these cannot be changed without re-initialising the cluster.
Leave 'pg_bits' at its default — the parameter is deprecated in recent Ceph versions and has no practical effect on modern clusters.
Never set 'disable_cephx' to true on any network that is not fully private and air-gapped; it removes authentication between all Ceph daemons.
Returns null on success (not a UPID); any error is surfaced immediately as an HTTP 4xx/5xx response rather than via a task log.
